summary: Closure review: the preregistered paired experiment and archived analysis are internally consistent and the manuscript correctly clarifies the shared_initial_candidate semantics and the unexecuted validator audit. The only remaining substantive defect is bibliographic: the manuscript has not been converted into a conventional IEEE numbered reference list tied to the in‑text numeric citations using the archived verified metadata.
critical_issues: References are not presented as a standard IEEE numbered bibliography using the archived verified bibliographic metadata; in‑text numeric citations (e.g., [1], [2]) must map unambiguously to full reference entries.
required_revisions: Replace the manuscript References section with a standard IEEE numbered bibliography using the archived terminal_bibliographic_records and any other verified metadata in the evidence bundle. Each entry must include full author list, title, venue or repository label (e.g., 'arXiv preprint'), year, and DOI/URL where available.

Ensure every in‑text numeric citation corresponds exactly to the intended numbered reference entry (no orphaned numeric citations or unreferenced bibliography items). Verify numbering consistency after insertion.

Resolve any ambiguous or placeholder venue text in cited records by substituting the verified venue/repository names from the archived bibliographic records; if venue metadata genuinely does not exist, label the entry clearly (for example, 'arXiv preprint') and include full author/title/year metadata.
optional_revisions: If space allows within the five‑page limit, add a brief table mapping generation semantics (shared_initial_candidate vs independent per‑condition draws) to the estimand each semantics identifies to aid reader design decisions.

If any archived validator‑audit artifacts exist (even partial), consider a short one‑paragraph appendix summarizing them; otherwise keep the clear statement that the preregistered 100‑case validator audit was not executed and therefore validator sensitivity remains unassessed.

Optionally include a very short illustrative paired example (one task) showing the shared_initial_candidate reuse and the validator trace excerpt, or else cite the exact archived trace file and its hash in the Disclosure for readers to inspect.
